name: AppcirclePublish
description: Upload a binary to an Appcircle Publish profile and/or trigger its publish flow.
author: appcircle

inputs.name: personalAPIToken
inputs.label: Appcircle Personal API Token
inputs.helpMarkDown: Appcircle Personal API Token used to authenticate Appcircle services.

inputs.name: authEndpoint
inputs.label: Auth Endpoint
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional: authentication endpoint for self-hosted Appcircle. Defaults to the Appcircle cloud.

inputs.name: apiEndpoint
inputs.label: API Endpoint
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional: API endpoint for self-hosted Appcircle. Defaults to the Appcircle cloud.

inputs.name: subOrganizationName
inputs.label: Sub-Organization Name
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional. Sub-organization name for the publish profile. Leave empty to use the root organization.

inputs.name: platform
inputs.label: Platform
inputs.helpMarkDown: Target platform of the Publish profile.

inputs.name: publishProfile
inputs.label: Publish Profile Name
inputs.helpMarkDown: Name of the Publish profile to target. Profile names are unique per platform.

inputs.name: upload
inputs.label: Upload binary
inputs.helpMarkDown: Upload the binary at App Path as a new app version. At least one of Upload or Publish must be enabled.

inputs.name: publish
inputs.label: Trigger publish flow
inputs.helpMarkDown: Trigger the profile's publish flow. With Upload, the uploaded version is marked release candidate and published; otherwise the profile's current release candidate is published.

inputs.name: appPath
inputs.label: App Path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path to the application file. Required when Upload is enabled. iOS: .ipa, Android: .apk/.aab.
